description: Quality gates fmt-check failed on crates/bitty-agent-api/src/error.rs:117 (and other reflowed lines). The repo's lint policy sets clippy::all + clippy::pedantic to warn at workspace level but the CI job runs clippy with -D warnings, which upgrades every pedantic lint (missing_errors_doc, doc_markdown, must_use_candidate, match_same_arms, too_many_lines, items_after_statements, redundant_closure_for_method_calls, range_plus_one) to a hard error. just check (fmt-check -> clippy -> test) never got past fmt-check on CI, so this debt was latent until now. Fix: cargo fmt --all, add missing # Errors doc sections, backtick DevTools/bitty-docs doc-markdown items, add #[must_use] where flagged, merge identical match arms, fix an exclusive-vs-inclusive range (two call sites), replace a redundant closure with char::len_utf8, move a const before statements in looks_like_secret_token, and justify two intentionally long hand-rolled scanning functions (scrub_quoted_keys/scrub_bare_keys) with #[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)] plus a doc comment explaining why splitting them would scatter shared cursor state. No behavior change: all touched functions keep their existing validation/scrubbing semantics; only docs, lints, and two mechanical arm merges changed.
title: Fix main CI: rustfmt diff in error.rs + full clippy pedantic debt
